paper_title: A Coin Has Two Sides A Novel Detector-Corrector Framework for Chinese   Spelling Correction
caption: Proportion of correct corrections among various error detection results in SIGHAN15. "P" signifies the errors in high precision results, "R" signifies in high recall results, "N" signifies not been detected. The suffix "W" indicates cases where correction has failed.

annotations.annotation: The two pie charts visually represent the distribution of categories in "All Changes" and "All Errors," comparing six distinct categories. Each chart has six slices. In the "All Changes" chart, the slices are labeled as follows: "P" is light green at 50%, "PW" is dark green at 4%, "R" is yellow at 26%, "RW" is brown at 14%, "N" is light blue at 1%, and "NW" is dark blue at 5%. In the "All Errors" chart, the segments are labeled as: "P" in light green at 56%, "PW" in dark green at 3%, "R" in yellow at 29%, "RW" in brown at 6%, "N" in light blue at 1%, and "NW" in dark blue at 5%. Both charts share a legend on the right side for reference, with percentage labels displayed next to each slice. The slices do not appear to be visually emphasized through any offset or explosion, and the segments are arranged in descending order based on percentage size.
